translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Wa, a Yave, ayi wuphani mvutu
bila ndidi nkua kiadi ayi ndidi nsukami.
Keba luzingu luama bila ndikiyekula kuidi ngeyo.
Ngeyo Nzambi ama, vukisa kisadi kiaku
kikusilanga diana.
Bika wumbona kiadi, a Yave,
Bila ngeyo ndieti tela mu lumbu kimvimba.
Nata khini kuidi kisadi kiaku.
Bila kuidi ngeyo, a Yave
ndieti vumuna muelꞌama.
Ngeyo widi wumboti ayi weti lemvukilanga ;
ayi widi wufuluka mu mamboti
kuidi bobo beti kutela.
Wa lusambulu luama, a Yave ;
wa bumboti yamikina kuama mu diambu di kiadi.
Mu lumbu ki ziphasi ziama ngeyo ndiela tela,
bila ngeyo wela kuphana mvutu.
A Va khatitsika zinzambi,
kuisi ko yoyi yidedikini banga ngeyo, a Yave
ayi kuisi ko mavanga madedakani banga maku.
Makanda moso momo wuvanga
mela kuiza ayi mela buongama va ntualꞌaku, a Yave,
ayi mela nata nkembo kuidi dizina diaku.
Bila ngeyo widi wunneni ayi ngeyo wumvanganga
mavanga matsiminanga ;
ngeyo kaka Nzambi.
Wundongi nzilꞌaku, a Yave
ayi ndiela diatila mu bukiedika buaku ;
bika wuphana ntima wukambu vasuka
muingi ndikinzikanga dizina diaku.
Ndiela kuzitisa, a Yave Nzambi ama,
mu ntimꞌama wumvimba
ayi ndiela kembisanga dizina diaku
mu zithangu zioso.
Bila luzolo luaku luidi lunneni kuidi minu
ngeyo wukhula mu zithipula zi tsi bafua.
Batu baluniemo balembo nduanisa, a Nzambi ;
ayi nkangu wu batu ba makhemi
balembo tombi luzingu luama ;
batu bakambulu thalu mu ngeyo.
Vayi ngeyo, a Yave, weti mona kiadi ;
yimonisanga nlemvo,
wuvika fuemanga ko ; fulukidi mu luzolo ayi mu kikhuikizi.
Baluka kuidi minu ayi wumboni kiadi ;
vana zingolo ziaku kuidi kisadi kiaku
ayi vukisa muana kisadi kiaku ki nketo.
Bika wuphana dimbu ki mamboti maku
muingi bambeni ziama zimona kiawu
ayi bafua tsoni
bila ngeyo Yave wutsadisidi ayi wumbombidi.
